coordinateConvention: SI physics: X right, Y up, Z toward near baseline; projected people in source pixels
calibration: Inferred 10.97 x 23.77 metre court; projective map through original four corners; vertical pixels/metre equals horizontal local scale. Not measured video calibration.
contactAssumptions: 固定正面法向；深度为有界引拍/前挥/恢复；仅初始化预览原正手，固定练习来球。
